The exchange, flipped

A standard landing page asks a stranger for their contact details in exchange for a brochure — a tired trade, and it converts like one. A quiz offers self-discovery first — “find out your result” — and the contact details arrive as a natural by-product of wanting the answer.

Better leads, not just more

Every completion arrives scored, segmented and self-described: their situation, their pain, their profile — known before anyone picks up the phone, landing in your CRM as rich, labelled data rather than a bare email address.

Follow-up that writes itself

They’ve told you what to say. Our most recent live deployment was producing sales-ready conversations within days of launch — a multiple-times lift, on traffic you’re already paying for.

iv · what the $5,000 build contains

One landing page. Three results pages. Video where it converts.

Quiz entry, offer framing and lead capture on the landing page. Three results pages — one per audience profile — personalised section by section to how each person answered. Video on the landing page and the core result page.

Planning weeks 1–2

  • Quiz concept proposal — the angle, the hook, and the outcome metrics we’ll track.
  • Question design — written to segment precisely, finish at high completion rates, and arm you with data that helps convert.
  • Scoring and routing design — how answers become scores, and scores route each person to the result built for them.

Construction weeks 2–4

  • Audience profiles agreed with you before build — scoring bands, character types, qualification.
  • Section-by-section personalisation on every results page, keyed to each respondent’s answers.
  • CRM integration, most platforms — field mapping and tagging so leads arrive labelled, not just listed.
  • All page builds, plus SEO setup — meta descriptions, titles, social share cards.
  • One complimentary lead magnet, with its automated delivery email.
  • A recommended follow-up email sequence per audience profile, ready for your CRM.
  • Abandoned-quiz capture and tuning — the almost-finished leads get a second chance.
  • Full analytics — GA4 events, Meta pixel and Conversions API, conversion events wired.
  • A retargeting audience built from quiz-starters — ready the day an ad campaign begins.
  • Privacy done properly — consent capture and notice on the form (NZ Privacy Act).
  • Full device QA, build documentation, a recorded handover walkthrough, and two revision rounds.
v · the care plan · $375 / month

Live, fast, secure — and still improving.

  • Hosting & SSL — your funnel stays live, fast and secure.
  • Uptime monitoring — watched around the clock; if it blinks, we know before you do.
  • Abandoned-quiz email tuning — ongoing tweaks so recovery emails keep working.
  • Text amendments, image swaps, link and button updates, quiz copy touch-ups.
  • Monthly integration health check — CRM connection, tags and lead alerts verified working.
  • Up to 5 change tickets a month — a ticket is one small change from this list, typically turned around within 2 business days. New pages, new audience profiles, new logic or redesigns are quoted from the add-on menu, so the plan stays simple and predictable.
